name: Pipeliners - Citation Audit 2026-09-24
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-09-24

# Summary
A read-only check of about 29 directories and listings for Pipeliners name, address, phone and website consistency (`citations.csv`). Many directories block automated fetches (HTTP 403 or Cloudflare), so several rows are "Could not check" or rely on search snippets.

# Key findings
- Found with correct name and the 633 W 2nd Ave, Mesa address: Yelp, Nextdoor, Superpages, Manta, Facebook, Birdeye, EZlocal, Central Index, SewerRepairHub, Ace DuraFlo installer locator.
- Unknown number (480) 969-7978 (owner must confirm): Birdeye (verified on page; profile UNCLAIMED, category "Contractors" not Plumber), Ace DuraFlo installer list (verified on page), Superpages and Manta (from search summaries only).
- Nextdoor's website link carries the GBP UTM tags, so Nextdoor clicks are reported as GBP traffic.
- Likely missing (not confirmed): BBB, Angi, HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack. Not in the Mesa Chamber member directory. location.com listing now 404 but still indexed.
- Possible name variant "Pipeliners LLC" on ZoomInfo (not attributed).
- Shared address: Schroeder Plumbing / On Services also list 633 W 2nd Ave; owner to confirm the relationship. The 969-7978 number does not appear on the On Services site.
- GBP included as a reference row only (read-only rule).

# Decisions and status
- Owner actions: confirm what 969-7978 is, claim Birdeye, correct listings. Feeds section C of the local SEO plan.
